svg.title: H0mework · 未干的地图
svg.desc: An unfinished map grows from a single source. Each territory joins only across a border it shares with one already drawn, and its colour spreads in from that border; a vermilion brush line records where it grew from. Old territories have dried to ochre, the newest are still wet, and the sea beyond the frontier has not happened yet. A red seal reads 源, source.
